answer: The shale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The prism holds work receipts rather than names, so the lotus of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
